title: Protein Quality Control and Organelle Turnover

scenes.visual: Title: Protein Quality Control and Organelle Turnover. Show an ER folding compartment beside a proteasome and a lysosome.

scenes.tts: A cell checks new proteins before sending them on. In the endoplasmic reticulum, or E R, secreted and membrane proteins get help folding. A protein that keeps failing is held back, then sent to the cytosolic proteasome through E R associated degradation. Why does this matter? Proteins misfold. The cell needs to destroy the failures instead of sending them on to the Golgi. Folding help and disposal work together to keep that protein checkpoint running.

scenes.visual: Open on the ER, labelled as a folding compartment. Split a protein route into folding success toward the Golgi and persistent failure retained in the ER. Trace the failed protein out to the cytosol, add ubiquitin tags, and deliver it to a proteasome. Label this route ER-associated degradation (ERAD). Keep this checkpoint visible throughout the opening.

scenes.tts: BiP helps a new chain fold. Calnexin and calreticulin hold proteins with a glucose tag. If a released protein is still not folded, U G G T adds glucose back for another round. Persistent failures leave by the degradation route: ubiquitin tags the protein, an ATPase pulls it out, and the proteasome destroys it.

scenes.visual: Show BiP binding a new chain. Follow a glucose-tagged protein through calnexin or calreticulin binding, glucose removal and release. UGGT returns a non-native protein to the folding cycle by adding glucose. Then follow a persistent failure through ubiquitination, ATPase extraction and proteasomal degradation. Use a generic ERAD route without a detailed channel architecture.

scenes.tts: The proteasome destroys single proteins. For whole organelles, the cell uses the lysosome. In macroautophagy, a membrane cup grows around cytoplasm and closes into an autophagosome with two membranes. It fuses with a lysosome. The inner membrane and its contents are digested. The building blocks return to the cytosol for reuse.

scenes.visual: Contrast a single chain entering the proteasome with cytoplasm and an organelle enclosed by a growing membrane cup. Clearly show two membranes after closure. Animate fusion with an acidic lysosome, digestion of the inner membrane and contents, and building blocks returning to the cytosol.

scenes.tts: What if unfolded proteins pile up in the E R? The unfolded protein response slows protein synthesis and makes more folding machinery. Mammals have three branches. I R E one splices X B P one messenger R N A. PERK slows most translation. A T F six travels to the Golgi to be cut. Unresolved stress can drive cell death.

scenes.visual: Return to unfolded proteins accumulating in the ER. Show the three mammalian UPR branches: IRE1 splicing XBP1 mRNA, PERK reducing most translation, and ATF6 travelling to the Golgi for cleavage. Converge on reduced protein load and increased folding machinery. Add a conditional arrow from unresolved stress to cell death.

scenes.tts: Autophagy can also choose its cargo. Receptors link particular cargo to the L C three family. Mitophagy removes mitochondria. In a well-studied route in cultured cells, PINK one builds up on depolarized mitochondria and recruits Parkin. Parkin adds ubiquitin tags. Receptors bind the tagged mitochondrion and recruit the machinery that engulfs it.

scenes.visual: Show a receptor connecting selected cargo to LC3 on a membrane cup. Then label a cultured-cell example: a depolarized mitochondrion accumulates PINK1, recruits Parkin and gains ubiquitin tags. Receptors connect the tagged surface to the engulfing autophagy machinery.

scenes.tts: Finally, how do you measure autophagy? More autophagosomes could mean more are made, or fewer are destroyed. Compare L C three two with and without bafilomycin. Assuming a complete lysosomal block, the difference reveals what would otherwise have been destroyed. Check cargo too. L C three marks the carrier. Read it alongside cargo measurements and fluorescent reporters to judge turnover.

Compare LC3-II with and without a complete bafilomycin block; label the difference as the LC3-II otherwise degraded.
